items.prompt: Capacity 2 contains (0,2); a nonblocking model push 3 reports full. What is queued afterward?

options.why: Rejected push is not accepted or delivered.

options.text: (0,3), because the failed push reserves the newest payload slot
options.why: A full rejection writes no slot and advances no index under this model; both previously accepted values remain queued.

items.explanation: The full rejection preserves both accepted items and the capacity invariant.
